title: Exponential Unary Scheduler
statement: For all natural numbers $C,c$, there exist a finite deterministic Turing machine $S$ over the Boolean alphabet and a natural number $B$ such that, for every Boolean input word $x$, $S$ halts after exactly $B\bigl(|x|+C\cdot 2^{(|x|+1)^c}+1\bigr)^{c+2}$ steps and outputs the word of $C\cdot 2^{(|x|+1)^c}$ ones.
replaced: For all natural numbers $C$ and $c$ there exist a deterministic machine $S$ and a constant $B$ such that on every input $x$, $S$ outputs the all-ones word of length $C \cdot 2^{(|x|+1)^c}$ within $B\,(|x| + C\cdot 2^{(|x|+1)^c} + 1)^{c+2}$ steps.
